name: RingCentral Events
description: RingCentral Events, formerly Hopin Events, is an all-in-one platform for producing branded webinars and virtual, hybrid, and onsite events. Event teams use it to build registration experiences, run live venues and sessions, engage audiences, manage schedules and sponsors, and measure event performance.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Events API bearer token and exact Organization ID, then let agents inspect that Organization, its first ten Events, one verified Event, and ten Schedule Items without exposing the token or Organization ID, attendee, registration, ticket, report, email, speaker, write, pagination, download, or raw API surfaces.

credentialRequirements.label: RingCentral Events OAuth bearer token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Provide a customer-owned Events API OAuth bearer token. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to api.events.ringcentral.com; no distributable external consent/token lifecycle is publicly documented, so Relay does not invent one.

credentialRequirements.label: RingCentral Events Organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact Organization ID to bind this connection. Health verifies that the token can read that Organization.

capabilities.label: Read bound Organization
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity for one exact RingCentral Events Organization.

capabilities.label: Read Organization Events
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded Events belonging to the exact Organization.

capabilities.label: Read Event Schedule
capabilities.description: List bounded Schedule Items without speaker or attendee data.

allowed.label: Read bound Organization
allowed.description: Read bounded identity fields for the exact RingCentral Events Organization configured on the connection.

allowed.label: List Organization Events
allowed.description: List at most ten first-page Events owned by the bound Organization.

allowed.label: Read one Event
allowed.description: Read one explicit Event verified on the bound Organization's first bounded page.

allowed.label: List Event Schedule Items
allowed.description: List at most ten first-page Schedule Items for one bounded Organization Event.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Event, template, ticket, registration, magic-link, report, booth, session, stage, schedule, tag, data-subscription, and webhook mutations are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block sensitive reads
blocked.description: Registrations, attendees, tickets, magic links, reports, analytics, engagement, booth contacts, speakers, emails, user IDs, and private metadata are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block broad and raw access
blocked.description: Other Organizations, pages after the first ten Events or Schedule Items, cursors, arbitrary filters, bulk work, downloads, and raw API access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four fixed Organization, Event, and Schedule reads run automatically; sensitive, mutating, broad, paginated, downloadable, and raw surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four selected reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact token and Organization authority, fixed routes, bounds, audits, secret isolation, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four typed RingCentral Events reads while keeping the customer token encrypted inside Railway's fixed Organization-bound adapter.
Relay mounts four typed RingCentral Events reads while keeping the customer token encrypted inside Railway's fixed Organization-bound adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: A representative RingCentral Events account, customer-owned OAuth bearer token, exact Organization ID, API access confirmation, staging credential entry, and live read validation remain for the separate provider-console task.
providerSetup.nextAction: After batch integration, an Events account owner must obtain a dedicated API bearer token through the provider-supported onboarding path, select an Organization ID, save both in Railway staging, and validate exact binding, first-page bounds, redaction, quota headers, token expiry/rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: The former Hopin site identifies the current product as RingCentral Events and describes branded event experiences, engagement, virtual venues, streaming, and community.
RingCentral presents Events, formerly Hopin Events, as its platform for webinars and branded virtual, hybrid, and onsite events with engagement and analytics.
The current RingCentral Events developer portal identifies a REST API with OAuth and current product ownership.

The API reference documents the fixed api.events.ringcentral.com/v1 origin, bearer authorization, Organization, Event, and Schedule Item reads, pagination, response shapes, and sensitive/write surfaces Relay excludes.
The provider documents migration of the external API to the current RingCentral Events domain and developer portal.
The provider documents per-authentication rate-limit headers and warns clients to honor changing server-provided limits.
